CustomField.formula:
IF(RecordType.DeveloperName == "Service_Request" && NOT(ISBLANK(Flight_Date__c)) && Departure_Time__c != "", Value( IF( Month(Flight_Date__c)<10, "0"& TEXT(MONTH((Flight_Date__c))), TEXT(Month(Flight_Date__c))) & IF( DAY(Flight_Date__c)<10, "0"&TEXT(DAY((Flight_Date__c))), TEXT(DAY(Flight_Date__c))) & TEXT(Year(Flight_Date__c))
)+ Value(LEFT(Departure_Time__c, 2)) + Value(RIGHT(Departure_Time__c, 2)),0)
CustomField.label: Flight Departure Time and Date
